intro k hr
let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
have h1 : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
let hk : ℕ := k
let hf : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
let h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / k.factorial)) :=
  tendsto_div_atTop_nhds (fun n => ↑(n.choose k)) (fun n => ↑n) (fun n => ↑k.factorial) hk
let h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k)) :=
  tendsto_rpow_filter (fun n => p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) k
let h4 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r^k / k.factorial)) :=
  tendsto_mul_filter h2 h3
exact h4
